info.name: Activity Tracker API — Full Coverage
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for the Activity Tracker Spring Boot API.

Covers all endpoints with happy-path, validation, authorization, edge-case, and concurrency tests.

## Setup
1. Start the backend (`docker-compose up` or `mvn spring-boot:run`)
2. Import this collection and the environment file
3. Run the **Auth > Register** request first — tokens auto-populate
4. Run folders top-to-bottom for best results

## Variables
- `baseUrl` — API root (default: http://localhost:8080)
- `accessToken` / `refreshToken` — auto-set by auth requests
- `userId` — auto-set on register/login
- `activityId` — auto-set on activity creation
